goals.instruction: Compare reference counting and tracing garbage collectors

memories.title: Held-out research H01
memories.text: Reference counting frees an object immediately when its last reference disappears, but it cannot reclaim isolated cycles.

relationship_dry_run.note: The local stub validates consent, payload binding, structured output, quotation validation and persistence. It does not measure relationship usefulness.

stopping_rules: Do not run paid Meta inference without a separate owner approval naming the exact model, payloads, call count, token caps, spend cap and abort conditions.
Do not tune the ranker after observing held-out results.
If the corrected ranker fails a criterion, report the failure and do not substitute a different scorer.
caveats: Lexical corpus; no semantic paraphrase claim.
Source-adequacy labels, not owner usefulness ratings.
The relationship dry-run is scripted plumbing, not evidence of model usefulness.
Held-out results are produced only after this protocol is committed; the evidence records the protocol commit.
